title: The runtime renders the position packet for the claude and codex hosts, with a receipt
summary: @inventarch/runtime exports renderHost(host, packet, digest, hostNote, target) and PACKET_MARKER from the package root and the new @inventarch/runtime/internal/packet-host subpath, with the PacketHost ('claude' | 'codex'), PacketTarget ('repository' | 'consumer'), HostFile, PacketReceipt and HostOutput types. renderHost renders one position packet, with the digest and host note renderPacket returned, as the host's files and returns the frozen HostOutput {files, receipt}; it reads no workspace and writes, deletes or plans no file. No host gets an agent file. claude renders .claude/rules/ia-workspace.md and .claude/skills/ia-authoring/SKILL.md for a consumer workspace, and CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/ia-authoring/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/ia-authoring/SKILL.md for the repository target; codex renders AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/ia-authoring/SKILL.md for either. Every file carries the marker `<!-- Generated by ia project; edit the cited native records. -->`, first in the entry file and after each SKILL.md's YAML frontmatter, and each ia-authoring skill keeps the authoring guidance previously rendered by compliance for that target, its marker line aside. The entry file holds the packet's sections in the packet's field order (seat, participants, mandates, system pointer lines, captured-record tallies, intent table, phase table, command catalog, SPEC lines), plain Markdown with one entry per list item or table row, so it renders entryCount(packet) entries, byte-identical for both hosts; then the line `ia-generated <revision> <packet digest> <adapter>`, where the adapter is ia-claude or ia-codex and names the package version (`ia-claude@<version>`) only in the consumer target, so a committed repository file does not change when a release bumps the version; then, in the consumer target only, a 'Host note (not part of the packet)' section with the freshness, installed state and key. The receipt, format ia.packet-receipt.v1, holds host, adapter (id@version in either target), revision, packetDigest, bodyDigest, entries, files (each rendered file's path and the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 text), removed, foreign, guard, hostNote, participants and mandates (the packet's `@agent` and `@mandate` identities), slug, cli and writtenAt. An unknown host or target, or a digest that is not the packet's, is refused with IA-RUNTIME-REQUEST-INVALID. The CLI's ia host, ia project, initialization with a host and installation refresh use this adapter to write consumer files and receipts; the repository projection generator writes the repository files. These replace the retired compliance renderers described in the replace-renderers note. Limits: renderHost itself leaves removed and foreign empty, guard 'none', cli null and writtenAt null for its applying caller to set; CLI-written receipts carry the CLI's id@version. Receipts carry no source digests or per-command consumer versions, and the host note's installed state stays unknown.
